reason: Passes the feasibility/schedule lens. (1) Build: verified in a scratchpad copy that build_probe_kernel.py accepts --patch divinsert+trainlab+safetail+lowrefine --lab with kernel_a's knobs plus LOWREFINE_ENABLE=1 (no refusal); 16 code cells all compile; only code cells 0 (env line) and 4 (predict literal) differ from the committed kernel_a. (2) Replay: the trainlab presafe hook sits at add_safe_divisions_postlink, after readmit/gapfill, so lowrefine is upstream of every dump; trainlab_io stores float64 so refined coords survive; the post cell is unchanged, so trainlab.py score and the parity gate work as-is. (3) Premise verified in _dl logs exp58 vs exp58t: geometric candidates 123/141/14/230 vs 121/155/13/222, DC-rejected 86/135/9/210 vs 84/149/8/203, accepted forks +1 of ~63. Lowrefine also moves readmitted-node coords sub-voxel, which can cross the forkmid audit's 0.7 um margin, so the mismatch is a real mechanism. It matters most for forkmid, which falls under R3 (lab audit is its real gate); K3b falls under R4 and needs +0.002 on the LB anyway. (4) Cost: 0 hidden-run time and 0 LB slots (the lab is never submitted). ~4 GPU-h. At 17:53Z both base shards were RUNNING, finishing ~19:15-19:45Z, leaving ~6 h of pre-reset quota. So the lowrefine shards fit either 19:45-21:45Z or 00:05-02:30Z, both well before S4 10:00Z and R8 (27.09 12:00Z). Caveats, not refutations: (a) the AND-veto rule must go into CONTEXT before ANY exp60 base result is read (base shards finish ~19:15-19:45Z), not merely before the lowrefine shards finish; (b) the 'rescue a rider rejected on the wrong base' gain contradicts the AND rule and is forking paths, so drop it (veto only); (c) the Saturday 00:00Z quota reset is unconfirmed (2020 staff post). If the shards run pre-reset and the reset slips, only ~2 GPU-h remain for the K3/K3b/K4/N1 dummies; (d) the laptop scoring load doubles.
fix: Write the decision rule into CONTEXT now, before any exp60 base-shard output is read. K3 needs the forkmid audit (0 TP removed) to pass on BOTH bases. K3b needs the E5 arc gate on both bases and the same t*. Lowrefine can only veto, never rescue, and the 56-clip lowrefine delta is recorded as in-sample only. Build the shards as exp60_x138_trainlab_lr_a/b with --out-dir exp60_trainlab/kernel_a_lr and kernel_b_lr, using the same split.json:A/B plus --patch lowrefine --set LOWREFINE_ENABLE=1. Push them right after the base shards finish only if Settings shows >= 5.5 GPU-h left, which keeps >= 1.5 h for the K3/K3b dummies if the reset slips. Otherwise push at 00:05Z once the quota shows the reset. If the shards are late past 09:00Z, K3 moves to S7 as planned. Optional cheaper variant (~1.2 GPU-h): one shard with only the 6bba CONFIRMATION clips plus clips whose base-lab forks sit within 1.5 um of 4.5 um. This must be pre-registered before the base results are read.
realistic_gain: Indirect and small: it avoids adopting forkmid (an R3 rider, accepted at >= -0.001 on public) on a lab reading from a mismatched base. That matters in maybe ~5-10% of worlds, worth -0.0005..-0.001 when it bites, so the expected value is ~+0.00005..+0.0001. It gives nothing for K3b beyond R4's LB +0.002 requirement. Cost: ~1 agent-hour and ~4 GPU-h, with no slots and no hidden-run time.
